capabilities: Search movies, TV shows, and anime across TMDB, TVmaze, OMDb, and MyAnimeList sources
Create notes from built-in or custom templates with posters saved into the vault
Maintain a library note with Dataview tables of movies, TV shows, and anime
Toggle watched status on open notes
Refresh TMDB-based notes and posters to comply with TMDB's six-month data limit
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. TV shows and anime need no API key; movies need a free TMDB or OMDb key. TMDB's API terms require refreshing TMDB-sourced notes every six months, which the plugin supports with a refresh command.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search media databases and turn the results into notes with posters and an overview table of what you watch.

relations.evidence: Built from Library Notes (same author) and the Obsidian sample plugin.
Media DB covers many more kinds of media (games, music, board games, and others)
The library tables use Dataview by Michael Brenan.
This product uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB.

requires.name: TMDB or OMDb key for movie searches

summary: Media note creator that searches TMDB, TVmaze, and MyAnimeList to build movie, TV, and anime notes with posters and a Dataview library note.
